promises.promise: A conversation is one agent talking in one place. Loom keeps one record for each, whatever the place, so a chat in loom, a Discord channel, a scheduled run and a handoff all look the same to every other part.
Each thing said or done is a turn: a message, a reply, an action, a wake, a note or a refusal. Loom records who it came from, when, and how it went. A turn holds no words.
When an agent finishes a stretch of work it writes a digest: a summary, what was decided, the tasks and projects it touched, and anything it needs from its owner.

That need becomes a question in the inbox, addressed to a person, with what happens on each answer. The answer, who gave it and when are recorded on the same item, and loom adds a new item for the agent, with answer as its source, so the agent learns of it.
Every inbox item names its conversation, and a digest points at the question it raised.inbox.conversation · digests.inbox_item
A trigger drops an item into the conversation's inbox, and a non-empty inbox starts the agent.inbox.source = trigger
A job works in one conversation, and a conversation points at the job working in it now.jobs.conversation · conversations.job
A session leaves a short note for the next one, and Activity builds each day from them.in the agent's own files
A conversation belongs to one agent, and optionally to a project or privately to one member.conversations.agent, project, member
a Three labels. Each conversation carries its agent, its project if it has one, and a member when it is private to one person.
b Who sees it. A household owner sees everything, including another member's private thread. Anyone else sees conversations in their projects and conversations of agents they own.
c Private. A thread in loom is private to its member. Private to a member means that member plus household owners.
d Checked at the door. Loom applies this to callers from outside: a person, an agent, a machine, someone's own program. Loom's own parts read without asking.
e Words. Message words are kept for the household's keep time, 14 days at most, then removed. They are encrypted where they are stored.
The private thread displays the person message and agent reply.
A question appears inline with Allow and Deny.
Work made in the conversation is listed.
